newsitem.title: FRANCE: Strauss-Kahn rejects cut in passbook savings rate.
newsitem.headline: Strauss-Kahn rejects cut in passbook savings rate.

text.p: French Finance Minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn ruled out on Thursday a cut in the Livret A passbook savings account, a measure called for by the Bank of France governor and commercial banks.

Asked by the managing director of bank Credit Agricole, Lucien Douroux, at a business conference, on the Livret A, Strauss-Kahn said: "You are not going to aske a leftist government which has just been elected to destroy the Livret A."
Strauss-Kahn did however say that the recent easier tone in money markets had "introduced a slightly bizarre hierarchy" between market rates and officially administered rates.
